head: 20ddbff7
headSubject: fix(verification-panel): attach X-Super-User-Key header on health fetch calls (SEC-13 regression)
summary: Fixed SEC-13 live regression: verification.html's refreshHealth/runHealthItem/stopHealthItem never attached X-Super-User-Key on their fetch() calls, so HEALTH_AVAILABLE never became true for a real Super User despite the server side being correct. Patched both emitters (NPDevCli/static_page_templates/verification.html.tpl and its duplicate inline copy in scripts/appgen/New-VerificationPanelPage.ps1) to read localStorage['npdev.controlpanel.key'] the same way control-panel.html already does and attach it on all three calls. Rebuilt WmsOffice, confirmed server-side via curl (401 -> 200), and confirmed live in a real headless browser via a new ScrapForAI routine (sec13-header-fix-verify-routine.json): #healthNote becomes visible and Run buttons render. Committed (20ddbff7). Also cross-checked the close-all-open-2026-09-22 plan against the live ledger: all 7 phases (REG-240/241/242/243/244, QUAL-41, B28) are genuinely DONE/LIFTED -- the memory note claiming phases 4/5/6/7 were still open was stale. Only QUAL-40 (WONTFIX, owner-accepted) is not DONE in the whole 505-item ledger; all 26 boundaries are LIFTED.
nextStep: The close-all-open-2026-09-22 plan's own Definition-of-Done checklist is the only remaining item: (1) run a full 'run-all-gates.ps1 -IncludeReleaseGate -IncludePaperwork' sweep -- only plain T2 has been run recently; (2) do ONE live browser session demonstrating all three reload behaviors together (orchestration rule edited+reloaded fires the new rule; a document added by reload renders; a concept added by reload is usable) -- each has been proven individually by tests/earlier sessions but never demoed end-to-end together in one browser pass per the plan's explicit definition of done. Consider whether the just-fixed SEC-13 header regression deserves its own ledger item (it was found live, fixed, and committed this session, but SEC-13 itself was already DONE as a feature so nothing tracks this specific regression+fix).
verified: Server-side: curl -H 'X-Super-User-Key: <key>' http://127.0.0.1:8100/api/admin/health/items returned 200 with real item data (was 401 before the fix). Browser: ScrapForAI routine sec13-header-fix-verify-routine.json ran 11/11 steps green against a rebuilt+running WmsOffice -- assertVisible #healthNote passed (HEALTH_AVAILABLE true) and assertCount button.actbtn.run >=1 passed (Run buttons rendered); only console noise was a benign favicon.ico 404. Ledger cross-check: grepped status:/classification: directly out of REG-240.yml, REG-241.yml, REG-242.yml, REG-243.yml, REG-244.yml, QUAL-41.yml (all DONE) and B28.yml (LIFTED) rather than trusting the stale memory note or the plan doc's framing.
